title: The Workflow plan dispatches the close-out beside the review, ignoring blocked_by
body: planFrom in epic-reconciler.ts flattens the graph's waves and sorts by skeleton rank, but never checks blocked_by: the close-out entry is dispatchable in the same window as the review it is blocked on (the existing tests assert this as intended behavior). The tracker declares the order; the plan ignores it, so this tick had to add a review-unsettled guard inside the close-out's admission to keep the PR body from predating the review's verdict. Either the plan should honour blockers like a local run does, or the divergence should be recorded as a deliberate semantics change (sz0).
